# Disagreement Log — 1QM Column 10

| # | Line | EMET | LOGOS | PNEUMA | Category | Resolution |
|---|------|------|-------|--------|----------|------------|
| 1 | 10:1 | "Who-is like-You, O God-of-Israel" | "Who is like You, O God of Israel" | "Who is like You, God of Israel" | Vocative | SOPHIA: "O God of Israel" with vocative O — preserves the liturgical register of the Hebrew |
| 2 | 10:2 | "people-of the-holy-ones-of the-covenant" | "people of the holy ones of the covenant" | "people set apart by Your covenant" | Theological phrase | SOPHIA: "people of the holy ones of the covenant" — kedoshim denotes holiness, not mere separation |
| 3 | 10:3 | "seeing the-formation-of the-luminaries" | "perceiving the formation of the luminaries" | "eyes that perceive the movements of the stars" | Cosmological term | SOPHIA: "perceiving the formation of the luminaries" — ma'arekhet ha-me'orot is technical; "movements of the stars" is reductive |
| 4 | 10:5 | "laws-of its-divisions" | "ordinances of its divisions" | "zones" | Terminology | SOPHIA: "ordinances of its divisions" — chuqqot preserves the legal/cosmic order language; "zones" is too modern |
| 5 | 10:6 | "circle-of the-seas" | "circle of the seas" | "ocean currents" | Cosmology | SOPHIA: "circle of the seas" — chug refers to the circular boundary, not currents |
| 6 | 10:6 | "seed-of Adam" | "seed of Adam" | "descending from Adam" | Register | SOPHIA: "seed of Adam" — zera' adam is a creation-theology phrase; PNEUMA paraphrases away the imagery |
| 7 | 10:7 | "confusion-of tongues" | "confusion of tongues" | "division of languages" | Biblical allusion | SOPHIA: "confusion of tongues" — preserves the Genesis 11 Babel allusion; "division" loses the confusion motif |
| 8 | 10:8 | "breath-of the-tongue" | "breath of the tongue" | "human speech" | Imagery | SOPHIA: "breath of the tongue" — the Hebrew image is concrete and physiological; "human speech" is abstract |
| 9 | 10:9 | "according-to their-mysteries" | "according to their mysteries" | "according to their hidden laws" | Terminology | SOPHIA: "according to their mysteries" — razim is a key Qumran term; "hidden laws" modernizes |
| 10 | 10:9 | "according-to their-office" | "according to their charge" | "their tasks" | Register | SOPHIA: "according to their charge" — mishmeret preserves the cultic/appointed-duty language |
| 11 | 10:11 | "spirits-of the-holy-ones-of-truth" | "spirits of the holy ones of truth" | "holy spirits of truth" | Word order | SOPHIA: "spirits of the holy ones of truth" — preserves the Hebrew construct chain; PNEUMA's rearrangement alters the meaning |
| 12 | 10:13 | "Worker-of-valor" | "Doer of Valor" | "Champion of Valor" | Divine title | SOPHIA: "Doer of Valor" — oseh chayil is literally "doer of might"; "Champion" adds heroic connotation absent in Hebrew |
| 13 | 10:14 | "piles-of the-slain" | "heaps of slain" | "heaped-up corpses" | Register | SOPHIA: "heaps of slain" — "corpses" (PNEUMA) is more graphic than the Hebrew chalalim warrants |
| 14 | 10:14 | "let-Your-sword devour guilty-flesh" | "let Your sword devour guilty flesh" | "let Your sword feast on guilty flesh" | Word choice | SOPHIA: "devour" per EMET/LOGOS — "feast" (PNEUMA) adds gratuitous connotation beyond the Hebrew tokhal |
| 15 | 10:16 | "Shine-forth in-songs-of-joy" | "Shine forth in songs of joy" | "Break out in joyful song" | Imagery | SOPHIA: "Shine forth in songs of joy" — hophia preserves the light/radiance imagery lost in PNEUMA's "break out" |
| 16 | 10:17 | "the-dust-of your-feet they-shall-lick" | "the dust of your feet shall they lick" | "lick the dust beneath your sandals" | Biblical imagery | SOPHIA: "the dust of your feet shall they lick" — PNEUMA's "sandals" is an addition not in the text |
